description: Live Amtrak train status from Amtrak's Track Your Train map feed: train number, route, origin/destination, state (Predeparture/Active/Completed), current GPS position, speed (mph), heading, last update, and every stop with scheduled and estimated/actual arrival and departure plus on-time/late comments. Filter by train number, route name or station code. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

route.description: Route name contains, e.g. Zephyr, Acela, Northeast Regional

station.description: Only trains stopping at this station code, e.g. CHI, NYP, LAX

name: travel_amtrak_train_tracker
title: Travel Amtrak Train Tracker
